translations.translatedText: # Thursday 16.12.2021 (radio)

Omicron spreads about 3 times more easily than delta. Finland requires a corona test from arrivals from Norway, Denmark, Britain and Nigeria. Sweden requires a corona pass from people coming from the Nordic countries. Corona home tests are selling a lot.
## Omicron

![A chair with text on its backrest reading: Corona vaccine queue. People waiting for vaccination in the background.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3839,h_2160,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-882853619ce79d82ac5/1637672976)
Open image viewer
People queued for a corona vaccine at the Limingantulli vaccination point in Oulu on 23 November. Photo: Risto Degerman / Yle

The Omicron variant of the corona virus may spread about 3 times more easily than the delta variant. This is what the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare, THL, says. It is not yet known whether Omicron causes a more serious disease than delta.
By Wednesday, 34 Omicron infections had been found in Finland. In total, almost 2000 new corona infections were reported in Finland on Thursday. Most new corona infections are in Uusimaa.
About 560 000 people in Finland have now received 3 corona vaccines. The vaccine gives good protection against serious corona illness.
## Finland's restrictions

![General view - in front of the new terminal at Helsinki-Vantaa airport.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5901,h_3319,x_0,y_312/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-88738661a8e3b0b3778/1638458523)
Open image viewer
Finland will require compulsory corona testing at the border from arrivals from Norway, Denmark, Britain and Nigeria. Photo: Esa Syväkuru / Yle
Finland is tightening the restrictions on entry.
People who come from Norway, Denmark, Britain and Nigeria must have a corona test at the Finnish border. The requirement applies immediately.
If a person comes to Finland from outside the EU, they must have a corona test already before the trip. Without a test you cannot get into Finland. This requirement will come into force next Tuesday.
A Finnish citizen or a person who lives in Finland may always come to Finland.
## Sweden's restrictions
![Asa Wernsten works at the corona virus test site at Arlanda airport](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11804538)
Open image viewer
The corona test site at Arlanda airport in Stockholm. Photo: Claudio Bresciani / EPA
Sweden is restricting entry because of corona.

Sweden requires a corona pass from people who come to Sweden from other Nordic countries. The corona pass must be in place from 21 December. Sweden did not previously require a corona pass from people who came to Sweden from the Nordic countries.
There are more corona infections in Sweden than before. However, there are fewer corona infections in Sweden than elsewhere in Europe.
Earlier this week Norway tightened corona restrictions. There are also corona restrictions again in Denmark.
## Corona home tests
![Corona rapid home test bought in Finland from Lidl](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4031,h_2267,x_0,y_378/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-806037609e0da90a227/1620971132)
Open image viewer
Corona home test. Photo: Minna Rosvall / Yle
Corona home tests are being sold in food shops more than before. In many shops, 4 times as many corona home tests are being sold as 5 weeks ago. In some shops all corona home tests have sold out.
You do not get an official test result from a corona home test. If the test is positive, the person must go to an official corona test.
